author: AtditC
body:
Hello Avicus Staff Members!

Here a report of a team griefer, which stole many iron armor sets and threw it into the void.

Name of Player being reported: erikcarl
Rule broken: Stealing Multiple Iron Armors > Team Griefing
Evidence: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SvM8hffkYjE
Anything else you would like to add? I recorded it on my alt account: xIDDoS and not on my main account AtditC

Description:

He took my crafter iron armor which I wanted to share with my team with putting it into chests at the spawn, and threw it into the void and even made suicide with iron armor, which was for the team. This is "Team Griefing" and I said MULTIPLE times before in the chat, that griefing will result in a ban, he ignored it.

Please deal with him, I'm really getting pi**ed off, of griefers destroying my iron shops.

Greetings,
Atdit
